user_query: I'm planning a trip to Italy with my family and I want to gather some information about the current Nav of mutual funds. Can you provide me with the current Nav of a few popular mutual funds? Additionally, I would like to get the OHLC history for the EUR/USD currency pair to analyze the forex market.

TaskList.description: Collect basic tourism information about Italy to assist in trip planning, such as popular destinations, travel tips, and accommodations.
Retrieve the current Net Asset Value (NAV) of several popular mutual funds for financial analysis.
Fetch the Open-High-Low-Close (OHLC) historical data for the EUR/USD currency pair to enable forex market analysis.
